extraction_notes: Parsed from the twenty-standard-application builders (source of truth for standard metadata at this commit).
Field defaults when unstated: isSystem=false, isNullable=true (create-standard-field-flat-metadata.util.ts).
'favorite' no longer exists as a workspace object (dropped by upgrade command 2-7 drop-favorite-objects; replaced by core navigationMenuItem).
view*, messageChannel, connectedAccount, calendarChannel, messageFolder are core (metadata-module) entities, not workspace standard objects.
